Create Location: POST /api/v1/admin/meters (via AdminMeters Add drawer, or UnifiedContextSurface Workflow placement modal)
Read Location: GET /api/v1/map/overview, GET /api/v1/admin/meters (Map, List, AdminMeters, Mobile ReadingBatch)
Update Location: PUT /api/v1/admin/meters/{id} (AdminMeters Edit Drawer, or UnifiedContextSurface change zone / metadata)
Delete / Retire Location: POST /api/v1/admin/meters/{id}/retire (UnifiedContextSurface "Ngung su dung" or AdminMeters row action); DELETE only if 0 readings
Map Actions: Spatial pin placement, relocation drag-and-pin, presentation zone reassignment

Create Location: POST /api/v1/admin/assets (via AdminAssets "Them thiet bi moi" modal, or POST /api/v1/admin/assets/import-candidates in Verification)
Read Location: GET /api/v1/admin/assets, GET /api/v1/admin/asset-network (AdminAssets table, UtilityNetworkView, AssetContextSurface, AdminVerification)
Map Actions: AssetLayer glyph rendering; click asset to open AssetContextSurface; "Xem tren ban do" camera center
Admin Actions: Verify asset, reject proposal, reopen review, relocate coordinates, attach meter, link parent asset

Create Location: POST /api/v1/admin/meter-asset-relations (AdminAssets detail drawer "Lien ket cong to" modal)
Update Location: POST /api/v1/admin/meter-asset-relations/{id}/transfer (transfers meter to new asset, closing old relation)
Map Actions: View measured/installed meters inside AssetContextSurface; click meter opens meter inspection
Admin Actions: Verify relationship evidence, reject relation proposal, close active relation

Map Actions: Interactive DAG rendering in UtilityNetworkView; upstream/downstream path tracing highlight

Create Location: POST /api/v1/meter-readings/confirm (Mobile App capture/OCR flow, or manual reading confirmation modal)
Read Location: GET /api/v1/map/overview (latest reading per meter), GET /api/v1/reading-batches/current, GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard (exceptions), GET /api/v1/reports/overview
Delete / Retire Location: Immutable audit record; soft review status via POST /api/v1/meter-readings/review
Map Actions: Display reading value on map pins and list table cells; click reading value opens AdminReadingInspection
Admin Actions: AdminReadingInspection OCR crop inspection; verify reading exception in Verification
